comparisonMethod: Read-only Python os.walk and SHA256 file comparison using COPY_IGNORE, RUNTIME_EXCLUDED_DIRS, SNAPSHOT_IGNORED_SUFFIXES, sha256_file, and snapshot_digest imported from scripts/run-pi-skill-eval.py, matching project audit_final_runtime_evidence.py. Run in workspace via python stdin; no canonical file writes.

gitNormalization.limitation: Working-tree byte parity passes independently of Git LF normalization. These accepted runtime CRLF text bytes would change in a new committed LF checkout unless publication preserves their raw bytes or validates the normalized payload. Binary provider SVG exceptions remain protected.

actualGitCleanCheck.command: git -C projects/colorset-audit/artifacts/release hash-object --stdin --path=<runtime-path> (without -w; read-only object hashing)

publicationReadiness.note: Read-only audit; no source edits, staging, commits, or pushes performed.
publicationReadiness.plannedPublicationValidation: Root explicitly chose normal Git LF publication with this disclosure, followed by validation of the committed LF checkout before push. Current report seals local working-tree parity with accepted Pi evidence; it does not claim accepted strict payload hashes will survive Git clean normalization.
